groups.sharedAction: Wave to a friend in the distance

variants.text: You wave to a friend in the distance, but they don't notice. Make your waves bigger and bigger until you're waving both arms.
performanceSteps: Wave to a friend in the distance
Wave more and more wildly to get your friend's attention.

variants.text: You wave to a friend in the distance, but several strangers wave back. Freeze, give a small dismissive wave, and point to your actual friend.
performanceSteps: Wave to a friend in the distance
React to the strangers waving back, then point to your friend.

groups.sharedAction: Open a gift box from a friend

variants.text: You open a gift box from a friend and find another box inside, then another. Keep opening them and stack the empty boxes higher and higher.
performanceSteps: Open a gift box from a friend
Open box after box and build a growing pile beside you.

variants.text: You open a gift box from a friend, but the gift fills the entire box. Spread your arms to measure it, then carefully lift it from both sides.
performanceSteps: Open a gift box from a friend
Measure the huge gift with your arms and lift it from both sides.

variants.text: You reach out for a handshake, but the other person squeezes much too hard. Your smile stiffens as you support your wrist and slowly try to pull free.
performanceSteps: Reach out for a handshake
Grimace, support your wrist, and try to escape the crushing grip.

variants.text: You reach out for a handshake, but the other person lets go immediately. Your hand hangs in midair before you quietly pull it back and straighten your sleeve.
performanceSteps: Reach out for a handshake
Pause with your hand in midair, then pull back and straighten your sleeve.

variants.text: You pose for a group photo, but the photographer takes forever. Struggle to hold your smile and pose, then rub your stiff cheeks.
performanceSteps: Pose for a group photo
Hold your pose for too long, then rub your aching cheeks.

variants.text: You pose for a group photo, but the photographer snaps it before you're ready. Freeze in surprise, fix your pose, and gesture for another shot.
performanceSteps: Pose for a group photo
Freeze at the early photo, then pose again and gesture for a retake.

variants.text: You listen to a friend's story and it gets more and more exciting. Your polite nods turn into wide eyes as you lean forward, eager for more.
performanceSteps: Listen to a friend's story
Widen your eyes and lean forward, eager to hear what happens next.

variants.text: You listen to a friend's story, but it keeps circling back to the beginning. Stop nodding, draw circles in the air, and shrug in confusion.
performanceSteps: Listen to a friend's story
Stop nodding, circle your finger, and shrug at the rambling story.

variants.text: You copy a friend's dance moves, but the beat suddenly speeds up. Swing your arms faster while staying in place, then gesture for them to slow down.
performanceSteps: Copy a friend's dance moves
Move your arms faster, then gesture that you can't keep up.

variants.text: You copy a friend's dance moves, but the beat suddenly slows down. Move in slow motion, pause mid-move, and wait for the next beat.
performanceSteps: Copy a friend's dance moves
Slow your movements and freeze while waiting for the next beat.
